findings.text: root_path is interpolated into a regex without re.escape, so regex metacharacters in it change the match or raise re.error. For example, root_path '/api(v1' raises 're.error: missing )', and root_path '/a.b' also strips '/axb/...'.

The prefix is stripped by regex without checking a path-segment boundary. root_path '/app' with path '/application/x' returns 'lication/x'. When the path doesn't start with root_path, nothing is stripped, so the path is returned unchanged and a mismatch goes unnoticed.
The new module-level import of starlette.types in _utils.py could create a circular import if starlette.types ever imports from _utils. This is a minor risk.

2.reason: This is a speculative future risk rather than a defect confirmable from the changed code.
